description: Builds an accounts receivable aging report from an invoice CSV: what's owed in each overdue bucket, by customer, with who to chase first and how late each customer usually pays. Use for overdue invoices, collections and cash flow. Read-only, and never uses the network. Results include customer names and amounts from the file, so they reach the model. It can't contact anyone.

as_of.description: Report date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default is today

columns.description: Column names by field (number, customer, issued, due, amount, paid, balance, paiddate, currency), when detection fails

date_format.description: dmy or mdy, needed only if the tool reports that dates are ambiguous

limit.description: Most customers to return, highest priority first, default 100. 0 returns only the totals

terms_days.description: Payment terms for invoices with no due date, default 30

name: receivables_aging_report
title: Accounts receivable aging report
